scope: Projects/Active/FDG Construction Procurement and Materials Control

findings.title: Voided transaction history allows a material unit change that breaks portable reload
reproduction: Create project C24-SYNTHETIC at2026-10-24; add Pipe/m requirement100.
Receive10m on2026-10-20; void MOVE-000001 with actual synthetic correction reason.
Edit MAT-000001 unit to pcs: material() accepts it.
findings.root_cause: material() protects unit only when an active order/movement exists, while normalize() validates unit against all retained transaction history including voided records.
findings.smallest_repair: Keep material identity/unit immutable after ANY retained order or movement for that material. Replace the active(s,'orders') and active(s,'movements') predicates in the existing material unit guard with all historical s.orders/s.movements. Preserve every voided row and reason; do not rewrite historical units.
required_checks: Unit change rejected after sole receipt was voided; original state byte-equivalent unchanged.
Unit change rejected after sole order was voided.
Same-unit target/name update remains allowed with voided history.
Unit change remains allowed before any transaction.
Current valid JSON and working HTML reload retain original units/history.

findings.title: Backup import accepts invalid order links on site issues/opening counts
reproduction: Create material Pipe/m; opening100m, active order80m and issue10m.
normalize accepts invalid order-linked issue even though move rejects it.
Same invalid link is accepted on Opening count.
findings.root_cause: normalize validates linked order identity/material/date but omits the permitted movement-type condition already enforced by move().
findings.smallest_repair: When x.order exists, reject any movement whose type is not Received or Returned to supplier before accepting the existing link validation. Apply consistently to active and retained voided records; preserve existing valid histories without migration.
required_checks: Reject linked Issued to site, Returned from site, and Opening count in backup preview.
Valid linked Received and Returned to supplier still round-trip.
Reject orphan/cross-material/voided-active-order links and pre-order dates as before.
Valid unlinked site issues and opening counts retained.

findings.title: Imported aggregate order overflow passes normalize then crashes rendering after state assignment

source.ui_context: commit-import calls normalize then change; change assigns state then render calls summary

reproduction: Create Pipe/m with one order quantity1e308, unknown rate; live engine allows it.
Append otherwise identical second order with distinct ORDER-000002 ID and quantity1e308 to synthetic JSON.
summary throws Order totals exceed the supported number range. Live order() blocks equivalent aggregate creation.
findings.root_cause: normalize runs per-item stock/linked-return validation but never the aggregate order summary validation enforced by live order().
findings.smallest_repair: Validate current-report aggregate projection before normalize returns a candidate, so preview rejects it without changing the live workspace. Also validate a proposed report cutoff in setup before returning the changed profile, since a previously safe imported timeline can become overflowing at another cutoff. Reuse existing summary guard; do not clamp totals or convert overflow into a zero/unknown value.
required_checks: Backup preview rejects2x1e308 outstanding order quantities; source and current workspace untouched.
Aggregate known-value overflow rejected on import with finite individual values.
Safe current cutoff with later orders does not become a live non-renderable state when cutoff changes.
Ordinary unknown prices, zero prices and finite large quantities preserve existing semantics.
All baseline67 checks and adversarial/recovery checks pass after repair.

release_requirements: Rebuild exact single HTML from canonical sources; refresh integrity/evidence and handover.
Run targeted UI preview reject/current-state preservation and native unit-edit protection after current browser gate clears.
Never promote procurement authority, QA, installation, accounting, cloud or human acceptance.
